headline: Keep your air conditioner's settings on track
intro: AC Defender watches the units you choose and can restore cooling or heating when something turns a unit off or changes its setting. Choose which guards are active with a switch for each one, and review what the defender is doing and why on its device page.
highlights: Select the units AC Defender should look after during setup
Enable or disable each guard independently
Review current activity, guards, cost and log on the device page

flow.title: Set up an AC Defender
stages: Add AC Defender in Home Assistant
Set guard switches and review activity
